responsibility: Defines the compile-time target description macros for the IQ2000 port that integrate it into GCC’s generic backend. It specifies ABI-visible data layout, endianness, type sizes, register numbering and classes, fixed/call-used registers, register allocation and reload rules, stack and frame conventions, argument/return register assignments, small-data and library/link specs, builtin target predefines, instruction-length adjustment hooks, and builtin IDs, serving as the central header that describes the machine model consumed by the rest of the port.
same_name_distinction: This is the target configuration header that provides macro-level machine model definitions consumed at compile time across the port, such as data layout, register classes, calling/stack conventions, reload rules, and builtin IDs. Unlike iq2000.cc, it contains definitions rather than hook implementations; unlike iq2000.md, it does not encode RTL insn patterns or scheduling attributes; unlike iq2000.opt, it does not describe user-visible target options.
